description: Worldview is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NASA Earth Science Data Systems Program. Access global satellite imagery layers and the underlying data from NASA to see how the entire Earth looks "right now." This web-based app gives users the power to interactively browse more than 800 global, full-resolution satellite imagery layers and download the underlying data. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality, Wildfire. Assets: Critical Facilities, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
